_note: Hearth talks to ONE local OpenAI-compatible endpoint on loopback. Any backend works (mlx_lm.server on a Mac, llama.cpp or Ollama on a PC). Sizes are measured safetensors totals from Hugging Face, not runtime memory.

fast.why: Fastest sensible choice; leaves most memory free

balanced.why: Better replies, still comfortable beside speech models

large.why: Mixture-of-experts, 4B active; needs a raised GPU memory limit on 24 GB
